title: SOUTHERN CALIFORNIA EDISON COMPANY Form 8-K — Q1 2026 Financial Results
summary: Edison International and subsidiary Southern California Edison Company filed a Form 8-K on April 28, 2026, reporting Q1 2026 financial results for the quarter ended March 31, 2026, along with a press release, conference call prepared remarks, and investor presentation attached as exhibits. This is a standard routine earnings disclosure filing containing forward-looking statements and standard regulatory language.
key_points: Edison International and Southern California Edison Company filed Form 8-K on April 28, 2026.
Reports Q1 2026 financial results for quarter ended March 31, 2026.
Attached exhibits include press release (99.1), conference call prepared remarks (99.2), and presentation (99.3).
Management held investor teleconference on same day.
Registrant is a California-incorporated utility company (IRS EIN: 95-4137452 for Edison International, 95-1240335 for SCE).
Forward-looking statements are subject to various risks and uncertainties.
